provisional_geometry.note: Maintainer-provided provisional rough polygons; not official redline; replace with official CAD/GIS on arrival and recompute area/metrics/layers.

area_method: Local equirectangular metric projection (lon0=116.34, lat0=39.97) approximating CGCS2000 / EPSG:4548 for this extent; exact EPSG:4548 reprojection recommended when official data arrives.
conceptual_items: Land-use partition, building footprints, road grid, phasing bands, landmark nodes are agent-generated conceptual layers.
FAR, building density, green/public/road ratios are directional design values, not statutory.
All scenario, branding, cultural, and operation content is conceptual co-creation, not approved arrangement.
